content.title: Tennessee-Michigan basketball time, TV, channel, streaming Elite Eight
content.text: MEN'S BASKETBALLTennessee-Michigan basketball time, TV, channel, stream in Elite EightDan HarralsonVols WireMarch 28, 2026, 8:18 a.m. ETUnmute0:00/0:00Full screenKeep WatchingNo. 6 seed Tennessee (25-11) will play in the Elite Eight for a third straight year. The Vols will return to action March 29 versus No. 1 seed Michigan (34-3) at United Center in Chicago, Illinois.Tipoff between the Vols and Wolverines is scheduled for 2:15 p.m. EDT. The Elite Eight matchup at the United Center will be televised by CBS.Tennessee advanced in the NCAA Tournament after defeating No. 2 seed Iowa State (29-8), 76-62, on Friday in the Sweet 16."Really proud of our guys and the effort they made, and against a team that they play as hard as any team we played all year," Tennessee head coach Rick Barnes said after defeating Iowa State.The winner between Tennessee and Michigan will advance to the NCAA Tournament Final Four. The Final Four will be contested April 4-6 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.Need a news break?
